did: Tested live in the browser pane by hand. The owner gave Napa 500 mg a weight (120 g) on the Weights screen, added a second courier (Sundarban Fast, with charges for own area, inside and outside the district) on the Couriers screen, and set the free-delivery limit above the order. A shopper then put one box of Napa in the cart and opened checkout.

checks.text: Checkout shows "Choose a courier - Weight 0.12 kg" with both couriers side by side: Sundarban Fast 90 taka and QA Express 94.50 taka, cheapest first
Choosing Sundarban Fast changed the order: delivery charge 90, total 390
The weight on the product is what the charge is worked from: the first kilo plus extra kilos, rounded up as the owner's rule says

notes: Done by hand in the live browser. Set-up done on the owner's own screens: the weight, the second courier, free delivery over 1,000 (it was 300 so the order was free) and the delivery-charge-paid-first limit set to never. Without a weight on every product the flat area charge is used instead, as the screen says. The order itself was not sent.
